dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.
Rules, gates, evidence checks, and validation criteria.
Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.
Known limitations, failure modes, and unsupported assumptions.

fusion_rules.rule: Review engineering delivery from fresh repository history, test health, plan completion, and team evidence.
Accept only: A time window, Git history, test health, plan state, delivery outcomes, and prior retrospectives.
Produce only: Individual and team feedback, technical-debt signals, trends, and tracked improvement actions.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: A time window, Git history, test health, plan state, delivery outcomes, and prior retrospectives.
output_boundary: Individual and team feedback, technical-debt signals, trends, and tracked improvement actions.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 自然日与自然周午夜绝对对齐规则：按日（d）或周（w）指定时间跨度时，必须显式计算本地午夜零点时间戳并附带 T00:00:00 后缀传递给 --since，严禁使用相对模糊字符串导致当前运行时刻裁切失真; 远端基线新鲜度前置拉取规范：在聚合指标前必须执行 git fetch origin <default>，若无 origin 或离线则记录失败标志并在报告中做无远端对齐披露; 陈旧基线与无效窗口阻断门禁：若远端拉取成功但最新 commit 日期早于统计窗口起点（today - window），必须强行阻断复盘流程并提示排查系统时间漂移或远端拉取陈旧，防止凭空捏造无事实根据的复盘假象
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: Git 提交历史检索与复盘时段窗口参数化解析; 工程复盘分析前的前置基线同步动作; 指标统计流水线启动前的绝对防御门禁
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 14 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (exception=1, gate=2, method=3, rule=6, template=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 历史对比与环比趋势分析机制：读取历史 .context/retros/*.json 快照，计算测试覆盖比率、会话数、LOC/小时生产率、修复比率及深耕会话数的指标差值（Delta）并生成对比表格; 社交级极简摘要模板：第一行输出单行紧凑速报，浓缩呈现周期、提交数、贡献者数、净增 LOC、测试行占比、PR 总量、峰值活跃时段及连续交付天数（Streak）; 计划达成度审计机制：调取交付审查日志中携带 plan_items_total 的记录，统计按计划交付的分支数、平均任务项完成率及最常被跳过的任务类别
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 存在一期及以上历史复盘快照时的时序比对流程; 复盘报告首行第一触点输出; 代码交付链路与规划计划绑定的交付效能审计
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 5 source-grounded atom(s) for method (method=3, template=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 社交级极简摘要模板：第一行输出单行紧凑速报，浓缩呈现周期、提交数、贡献者数、净增 LOC、测试行占比、PR 总量、峰值活跃时段及连续交付天数（Streak）; 个人深度复盘与团队成员画质结构模板：为个人提供亮点表扬（Praise，锚定提交）与跃升建议（Growth），为每位队友细分交付成果、真实评价与 1 个针对性成长契机，客观披露 AI 协作比例
